interpretation: Measured tree topology and patristic-distance geometry explain a minority of the prospective AusTraits family-level context, especially via pairwise-distance CV, but they do not remove it. Roughly 79% of S3 and 85% of prune family variance remains after joint adjustment.
hard_nonclaims: Persistence after these metrics does not prove the remainder is biological.
The geometry metrics are correlated and their one-at-a-time coefficients are not causal effects.
This is a post-outcome sensitivity analysis.
